name: Accordion
summary: List of sections you can open and close. The panel is a native Figma slot.
use: Long pages where the user looks for one part.
avoid: Content everyone must read: just show it.
anatomy: Header button with a title and a chevron.
figmaProps: Group with 10 items, 4 on by default. Title and Expanded per item in the properties panel.
reactProps: Default 3. Choose what fits the page.
behaviour: Click, Enter or Space on the header opens or closes the panel.
a11y: The header is a <button> inside a heading (h2 to h4) with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
The panel has aria-labelledby. It is a region with 6 items or fewer; more regions would crowd the landmark list.
content: Titles as a question or a clear topic.
do: Choose the right headingLevel so the heading structure is correct.
